Acne and pimples can leave behind dark spots and uneven pigmentation even after the breakouts have settled. These marks do not fade overnight. Their appearance depends on the cause, skin type and depth of pigmentation, so gentle care and patience are essential.
In this video, Hansaji discusses traditional skincare ingredients, nutrition and daily habits that support healthy skin and help prevent further irritation.
You will learn about:
1. A traditional face pack using rose petal powder, neem, turmeric and sandalwood.
